title: Modular Arithmetic
seo_title: Modular Arithmetic – SSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add, subtract and multiply in modular arithmetic; solve simple congruences; use modular arithmetic for days of the week and clocks. (summary of the NERDC SSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free SSS 1 maths worksheets on modular arithmetic: addition, subtraction and multiplication mod n, solving congruences, tables, days of the week and clock problems. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • In mod n, every number is replaced by its remainder after dividing by n.
  • Do the working as usual, then divide by n and keep the remainder.
  • A negative answer is made positive by adding n: −2 mod 7 = 5.

Examples

Example

(8 + 9) mod 5

17 = 3 × 5 + 2

Answer: 2

Example

Solve 3x ≡ 1 (mod 5)

3 × 2 = 6 ≡ 1

Answer: x = 2

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Giving the quotientThe answer is the remainder.
Leaving a negative answerAdd the modulus until it is between 0 and n − 1.
Using 12 o’clock as 0On a clock, a remainder of 0 means 12 o’clock.

items.q: A clock shows 6 o’clock. What will it show 51 hours later?
items.e: A clock works in mod 12. 6 + 51 = 57, and 57 leaves 9 after taking away twelves: 9 o’clock.
